preprocessing.name: canonical256_jpegmixed_methodquality_adaptive_letterbox299
preprocessing.source_decode: Pillow decode followed by RGB conversion
preprocessing.train_only_augmentation: random horizontal flip p=0.5 followed by one uniformly sampled JPEG quality

objective.groups: Real or one of six seen fake methods crossed with JPEG quality Q75/Q80/Q85/Q90/Q95
objective.excess_loss: max(EMA loss(method, quality) - EMA loss(method, Q95), 0)
objective.class_mass: Real and Fake retain equal expected objective mass; adaptation occurs separately within each label
objective.weight_update: online after each batch for use by the next batch
objective.classification: single-view weighted cross-entropy; no consistency, distillation, or second supervised view

optimization.epoch_sampling: all 39600 unique training images once per epoch with the frozen 50:50 Real/Fake marginal
optimization.comparison_budget: same unique-image count and one-view forward-pass count as M7 Mixed-JPEG

model_selection.reason: Keep checkpoint selection directly comparable with M7 Mixed-JPEG; method-quality weights use training batches only.

baseline_references: M7 family Group DRO plus paired-JPEG consistency seed 42
